title: Kling V3 Omni
summary: Generate video with Kling V3 Omni
description: Kuaishou Kling V3 Omni — text-to-video; image-to-video (start + optional end frame); reference-images-to-video (up to 7 images); and video-to-video editing (supply a `video` of 3-10 seconds: the output keeps its length, shape and sound). 720p (standard), 1080p (pro) or 4K, any duration from 3 to 15 seconds, optional generated audio. Billed per second of output: 720p 219 (292 with audio), 1080p 292 (364 with audio), 4K 546; editing a video 219 at 720p and 292 at 1080p, for the clip's length (no 4K and no generated audio when editing). See `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models and POST /v1/cost.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Ignored when an input image or video already sets the frame.

end_image.description: Optional end frame, used together with `image` (the start frame) to interpolate the video between the two frames. Same input forms as `image`.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video. Raises the 720p/1080p per-second rate (no price impact at 4K); unavailable on video-edit.

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. JPG or PNG, at least 300px on each side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2. Omit for text-to-video. Can't be combined with `reference_images`.

length_seconds.description: Video length in seconds (3–15). Ignored when editing a `video` (the output keeps its length).

prompt.description: Text description of the video, or the change to make when editing a `video` (up to 2,500 characters). Reference images may be named in the prompt as <<<image_1>>>, <<<image_2>>>, ... in the order sent, and the video to edit as <<<video_1>>>. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images that guide the generated video. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image` (start/end frames). Up to 7 on their own (reference-images-to-video); up to 4 when accompanying a `video` edit.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 720p (standard), 1080p (pro) or 4k. Pricing varies by resolution — see `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models.

video.description: Optional video to EDIT (MP4 or MOV, 3-10 seconds, 720-2160 pixels on each side, up to 100MB). Provide a public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads (videos are passed by URL, not inlined). The request then runs in video-edit mode: up to 4 `reference_images` may guide the edit, start/end frames are not supported, the clip keeps its own sound and no audio is generated, and the output keeps the clip's length and shape, so `length_seconds`, `aspect_ratio` and `generate_audio` are ignored. Billed per second of output at the edit rate, for the clip's length rounded up to a whole second (measured by us). 720p or 1080p only: 4K can't edit a video.
